Type: Region (Wilderness)
First Visited: Session 0

Description

An independent region of cliffs, ravines, and treacherous terrain.
Lies between @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s environs and the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium}.
A labyrinth of broken rock — confusing and dangerous to navigate.
The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} cut through, providing the only reliable passage.

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — The kingdom to the west
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium} — The great lake to the east, accessible through the river passages
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} — Cut through the Cragmarr, providing passage

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as the treacherous terrain between Beaconhold and the Solvium
